pages.text: Look for forked junipers in forest or hill biomes. Use a free hand on fruiting leaves to pick one berry. Tree-grown leaves can fruit again. Break or let leaves decay for a chance at saplings.

pages.title: Orchard
pages.text: Plant juniper saplings like ordinary trees, with room above. Leaves placed by hand are decorative and stay unfruited. Eat the berries or use them in $(l:psychedelicraft:preparations/mash_catalog)juniper mash$(/l).
Use the wood for vanilla-style parts, signs and boats.
Add a chest to the boat for a floating inventory.
Log and wood forms also make charcoal.
